A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same POLAR study. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support a complete comparison, including v4's added Appendix I.

before.justification: v3 reports original POLAR experiments on nuScenes, ZJU-4DRadarCam, and View-of-Delft, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, robustness analyses, and computational measurements.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The radar prototypes, feature aggregation, MDE-radar fusion, polynomial coefficient prediction, and first-derivative regularization are unchanged. Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same procedure and objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three datasets, cross-dataset generalization, and reduced radar density scenarios. Appendix I's references to robots and AR/VR glasses are deployment aspirations, not additional evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the corresponding experiments, including RadarNet, SparseBeatsDense, GET-UP, RadarCam-Depth, TacoDepth, and the appendix depth-completion, adapter, and regression comparisons. Newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: The MAE/RMSE metrics, 50/70/80-meter thresholds, dataset splits and crops, training settings, and cross-dataset and radar-sparsity procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the polynomial-degree sensitivity study, component ablations, backbone comparisons, zero-shot transfer, radar-density tests, regression comparisons, and qualitative case studies. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix G retains the same uncertainty procedure: Kendall's tau over 30 bootstrap samples and a two-sample t-test comparing POLAR with raw MDE predictions. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: Tables 1–14 retain their result entries and numerical values, and the qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 still reports POLAR's 80-meter nuScenes MAE/RMSE as 1407.8/3193.5 mm; Appendix G retains p = 0.012.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7, Appendix B's computational derivation, and Appendix H's proposition, constructive proof, and corollary are unchanged. The new discussion introduces no formal result or assumption.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same polynomial-fitting novelty, monotonicity-regularization contribution, and accuracy/efficiency claims. The abstract's average MAE and RMSE improvement claims remain 24.9% and 33.2%.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, interpretations of experiments, and limitations concerning polynomial-degree selection and oscillation remain unchanged. Appendix I mostly reiterates radar's practical advantages and adds general deployment aspirations, without new substantive qualifications or result interpretations.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures are retained, including 60 training epochs, the cosine learning-rate schedule, learning rate 5 × 10^-5, loss weights, preprocessing, and GPU/timing information. No new implementation or code/data access information is provided.

R1.justification: The literature coverage expands substantially across foundational monocular depth, depth-completion adaptation, multimodal perception, embodied applications, and optimization. References increase from 64 to 93, with additions including Make3D, ETA, ORCAS, and IRIS, while the former RSA citation is removed. Section 2 and new Appendix I incorporate this broader context, although POLAR's central novelty positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited introductory wording edits, adds a funding acknowledgment and a short Appendix I discussion, and updates citations and bibliography entries. The existing narrative and section organization otherwise remain intact.

P2.justification: The expanded bibliography and acknowledgment cause limited text reflow and shift the supplement's starting page. All seven figures and fourteen tables retain their content, designs, and captions apart from citation updates; there is no substantive visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The broader citations and funding acknowledgment add contextual completeness, but Appendix I largely restates existing motivation. The method, experimental evidence, theoretical justification, reproducibility information, and substantive limitations remain unchanged, with no meaningful net gain or loss in overall paper quality.
